owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

feeReserveBps().notice: Share of the WETH leg of fee-only collects unwrapped to ETH (idle, not deployed to LP). LP-owned.

lastReservedEth().notice: Prior native ETH reserve (`address(this).balance`) before the latest unwrap/wrap checkpoint.

maxOffensiveRatchetCount().notice: Last consecutive OFFENSIVE entry that applies below-range ratchet tightening.

minFloorTickCount().notice: OFFENSIVE re-mints use `offensiveAssetBps` only after this many consecutive OFFENSIVE entries.

minRangeBelowTicks().notice: Floor for tightened below-range during OFFENSIVE ratchet (multiple of `tickSpacing`).

mintNewPosition().notice: Drain LP (if any) and remint current ASSET with current band params (`rangeBelowTicks` / `rangeAboveTicks`).

offensiveAssetBps().notice: ASSET share target (bps) after `minFloorTickCount` consecutive OFFENSIVE entries.

protocolFeeBps().notice: Share of collected Uniswap LP fees sent to `feeManager` (1000 = 10%).

rangeAboveTicks().notice: Tick distance above base (multiple of `tickSpacing`). Default

rangeBelowTicks().notice: Tick distance below base (multiple of `tickSpacing`). Default

ratchetNumerator().notice: OFFENSIVE below-range ratchet multiplier: effective *= numerator / denominator each step.

reservedEth().notice: LP-owned idle fee buffer held as native ETH (invisible to ERC20 LP/swap paths).

targetAssetBps().notice: ASSET share target (bps) for NORMAL / DEFENSIVE / pre-confirmation OFFENSIVE re-mints.
